question: Which Go and gh minimum versions and release OS/architecture targets should be supported?
status: Initial implementation: Go 1.25 language minimum with Go 1.27.3 toolchain; gh 2.103.3 tested baseline; linux-amd64, darwin-arm64 and windows-amd64 targets gated by native CI before publication.

question: Which bounded concurrency and retry limits should discovery use?
status: Resolved: four workers; 30-second requests; two retries for network/5xx failures; no rate-limit retry. Finite metadata and traversal limits are documented in TECHNICAL_DESIGN.md.
